title: How to Get a Job at Okta in India in 2026: Process and Tips
excerpt: Okta lists 113 India roles, 111 in Bengaluru. See its published interview steps, what candidates report, and the identity skills to prepare before applying.
content:
Okta, the San Francisco identity and access management company, does almost all of its India hiring in Bengaluru, and most of it is senior engineering. As of 4 October 2026, its official Greenhouse job board lists 113 India-based roles out of 368 worldwide, and 111 of them are in Bengaluru. To get in, apply to a specific posting, then expect a recruiter screen, technical interviews and a hiring-manager conversation. Many candidates also report a timed online coding test first.

100Xfounder is an independent site. This guide is not official, and we are not affiliated with or endorsed by Okta. Confirm every detail with your recruiter and on Okta's careers site.

Key takeaways

  • Bengaluru is the whole story. 111 of 113 India roles are there; one sales role each is listed in New Delhi and Mumbai.
  • It is an experienced-hire market. By our count, about 82 of the 113 roles are software or reliability engineering, and staff, senior and principal titles dominate.
  • Okta publishes its process only for early-career roles: a CodeSignal pre-screen, recruiter screen, technical interview and hiring-manager interview for technical interns.
  • Expect hybrid work. 99 of the 113 India postings carry Okta's hybrid tag, and new hires get in-person onboarding.
  • Identity knowledge helps. Many postings list OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM or directory services such as Active Directory and LDAP.

Okta in India: from new office to engineering hub

Okta's India story is recent. In August 2023, DQIndia reported that Okta had opened an office in Bangalore with its first innovation centre in the Asia Pacific region. Okta said then that it planned to create hundreds of roles over three years and that the India team would start owning product areas from 2024.

By November 2024 the pace had picked up. According to a PTI report carried by The Week, Okta said it had tripled its India workforce to 300 in a year and planned to hire more than 200 more people over the next year, mainly in engineering and solution development, taking headcount past 500. Ben Goodman, Okta's senior vice president and general manager for Asia Pacific and Japan, called India a key part of its growth and innovation strategy, and said Okta was launching a new Innovation Centre in Bengaluru.

Okta's own Bengaluru office page now calls the site its "India Innovation Centre". It says teams there work on foundational technology for both the Okta and Auth0 platforms (Auth0 is Okta's developer-focused identity product), on secure AI, and on global operations. Teams based there include product and engineering; technology, data and intelligence; customer success; sales and marketing; and people and workplace operations.

Which roles are open in India right now

We pulled Okta's public Greenhouse feed on 4 October 2026. Grouping the 113 India roles by title gives this picture:

FunctionApprox. rolesExamples from the board
Software engineering and architecture69Senior, Staff and Principal Software Engineer; fullstack, Java and Node.js roles; macOS, Windows and Android; engineering managers and architects
Site reliability and infrastructure13Senior and Staff SRE, Kubernetes platform SRE, Staff Network Engineer, Staff DevSecOps Engineer
Data and analytics8Senior Data Engineer, Senior Data Analyst (including Auth0), People Analytics
Product, design, writing and identity specialists9Senior Product Manager, UX researchers, Staff UX Designer, technical writers
Sales, partners, solutions and other business roles14Enterprise Account Executives in Bengaluru, Delhi and Mumbai, solutions engineers, partner operations, finance and people roles

The engineering work is spread across Okta's core identity platform, applications, infrastructure, the Auth0 customer identity products (listed as CIAM, customer identity and access management), privileged access management (PAM) and lifecycle management, which handles how user accounts are created, synced and removed. Experience bars are explicit. A typical Senior Software Engineer post asks for five or more years building reliable software, Java or another object-oriented language, relational databases, REST APIs and directory services. Staff roles usually ask for seven to eight years or more, and principal roles often ten to twelve or more.

Entry-level roles are scarce. The only "associate" title on the India board that day was an Associate Solutions Engineer post, and it asked for four or more years of pre-sales experience. Okta's intern programme page does list Bangalore among its intern locations, so watch that page for student roles. You can browse current openings on our Okta jobs page, which is refreshed from the same official feed, or compare them with other engineering jobs in Bengaluru.

How Okta works: hybrid and in person at the start

Okta's India postings are tagged hybrid; 99 of the 113 carried the tag when we checked. The standard text at the end of each post says Okta has more than 20 offices worldwide and that every new hire starts with an "immersive, in-person onboarding experience". Plan to live within commuting distance of the Bengaluru office unless your recruiter says otherwise.

What Okta looks for

Okta's careers page describes a "high-performance culture" with five values: love our customers, always secure, always on, build and own it, and drive what's next. Its operating principles add: raise your own bar, turn action into traction, thrive in change, and move fast, simplify, repeat. For early-career hires, Okta says it wants builders focused on concrete outcomes rather than effort alone, and people who see change as a chance to improve.

Inside the Bengaluru office, a senior recruiter quoted on Okta's office page describes a culture built on an "owner's mindset": if you see a problem, you have the autonomy to fix it. Expect interviewers to look for that. Prepare stories where you spotted a problem nobody owned and fixed it.

Because Okta sells security, its technical bar has a security flavour. Postings mention identity protocols (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM), Active Directory and LDAP, and in reliability roles, AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform. In our count of the 113 India postings, Java appears in 49, OAuth in 37, Python and SAML in 34 each, and Kubernetes in 27. You do not need all of these, but knowing how a login, a token and a provisioning flow work will help in almost any Okta engineering interview.

The hiring process, step by step

Okta publishes interview steps only for its intern and early-career programme. For technical roles the intern page lists:

  1. CodeSignal pre-screen, an online coding assessment on an outside platform.
  2. Recruiter screen.
  3. Technical interview.
  4. Hiring manager interview.

For non-technical roles, the steps are a recruiter screen, interviews with team members, and a hiring-manager interview. Okta's careers page also links to an interview guide hosted on Splash; open it before your first call, since the official guidance there may be more current than any third-party summary.

What candidates report for experienced roles

The following is based on candidate reports, not on Okta. DesignGurus, a third-party prep site, compiled candidate accounts in September 2026 into five stages for software engineers:

  • Recruiter screen of about 30 minutes on background, level and motivation.
  • Online coding assessment, often on CodeSignal, typically 70 to 90 minutes with easy-to-medium problems.
  • Hiring manager call of 45 to 60 minutes on past projects and decisions.
  • Technical loop of up to three roughly hour-long interviews covering live coding, system design and identity basics. Junior candidates often skip design; senior and staff candidates report a deeper architecture round.
  • Behavioural round on collaboration, ownership and customer trust.

The same summary says most candidates finish in three to six weeks. Some report that the live-coding round revisits their assessment code and asks them to explain and improve it. Your recruiter will confirm the loop for your team and level.

How to stand out

  • Apply to the exact team. India postings name teams such as Lifecycle Management, PAM, Identity Administration, Workflows and Auth0 developer tools. Tailor your resume to that team's stack: Java and Spring, Node.js, Go, macOS or Windows clients, or Kubernetes.
  • Learn the identity basics. Be able to explain OAuth 2.0 versus OpenID Connect, what SAML does in single sign-on, and how SCIM provisioning works. Okta's own developer documentation is free.
  • Practise timed coding. If a CodeSignal test comes first, a working answer under time pressure matters more than an elegant one you cannot finish.
  • Bring outcomes, not effort. Okta says it values concrete results, so quantify what changed because of your work: latency, incidents, adoption or revenue.
  • Show you think about security and reliability. "Always secure, always on" is literally in Okta's values. In design rounds, discuss failure modes, rate limits, audit logs and how you would protect secrets.
  • Have an ownership story ready. The Bengaluru team describes an owner's mindset, so expect "tell me about a time you fixed something nobody asked you to".

Pay, notice periods and offers

Okta's India postings do not publish salary ranges, and we have not found an official India pay range, so we do not quote one. Recruiters typically discuss expectations early. Offers in India are usually expressed as CTC (cost to company) in LPA, meaning lakh rupees per annum (one lakh is ₹100,000). Equity at US-listed companies usually comes as RSUs (restricted stock units); confirm how they are taxed in India with a qualified tax adviser. Use our in-hand salary calculator to see what a fixed salary means each month, and our notice period buyout calculator if you need to leave a current job faster.

Bottom line

Okta has turned Bengaluru from a new office in 2023 into a large engineering centre that builds parts of both the Okta and Auth0 platforms. For candidates, that means plenty of openings but a high bar: most India roles are senior, staff or principal, and they reward real experience with identity, distributed systems and reliability. Read Okta's values and interview guide, brush up on identity protocols, practise timed coding, and apply to the team whose problems you already understand.

FAQ

Where is Okta hiring in India?

Almost entirely in Bengaluru. On 4 October 2026, 111 of Okta's 113 India roles were in Bengaluru, with one enterprise sales role each in New Delhi and Mumbai.

What is the Okta interview process?

For technical interns, Okta lists a CodeSignal pre-screen, recruiter screen, technical interview and hiring-manager interview. Candidates for experienced roles report a similar flow plus a multi-interview technical loop and a behavioural round.

Does Okta hire freshers in India?

Rarely, judging by the current board. Okta's intern page lists Bangalore as an intern location, but no India internship or graduate role was open on 4 October 2026.

Is Okta India remote?

Most India roles are tagged hybrid, and Okta says new hires get in-person onboarding. Ask your recruiter about office days for your team.

What skills should I learn for an Okta interview?

Coding fundamentals and system design, plus identity basics such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML and SCIM. Reliability roles often add AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform.
